conjunctionRule: all clauses must hold; the predicate is evaluated only over the full gate and no clause may be waived by another clause passing

workflow-parity.requirement: parity-or-better on every required workflow row

metricSet: real-client-responsiveness (actual client application/paint, not server-side latency alone)
outbound-bytes (wire bytes for the same interactions)
measured-advantage.thresholds: predeclared margins in the shared performance contract (WSP lineage); recorded before measurement, never selected post-hoc

verter-specific-semantic-tooling.requirement: at least one differentiating Verter semantic capability the official product does not provide, demonstrated executable and exposed per DX0 section 6 (executable route, source-linked explanation, reproducible scenario, observable error state), not merely registered

methodology.equalWorkCorpus: WSP's equal-work corpus and the shared-contract limits, with all required features enabled on both sides per the manifest attestation

comparatorMode.note: a comparator with diagnostics disabled voids the campaign (JBT0-AC1)

methodology.sameBasis: identical source revisions, corpus and host hardware in one campaign; every run binds the DX0 ProductReceiptBasis; old-source, old-project, old-engine, old-worker and wrong-handle runs are rejected on both sides

unavailableMetrics.note: unavailable metrics are labelled with a reason; never guessed as zeros and never silently omitted

methodology.incrementalVsFresh: where the adapter changes caching, mapping, snapshots, result handles or incremental publication, incremental and fresh execution are compared on the same basis; JBT1H owns the harness binding and JBT10 owns the comparative qualification (JBT0-AC-BASIS)
methodology.requiredWork: a performance result obtained by doing less required work is void and triggers the claiming node's abort/replan condition
methodology.claimScope: claims are scoped to the measured matrix rows and corpus; no general performance claim follows from a compiler microbenchmark

thinLspPlugin.note: a thin LSP plugin reaching the IDE through verter-lsp satisfies no clause of this predicate by itself (JBT0.4)

terminalOwner: JBT11 evaluates the conjunction; installation, protocol smoke, or screenshot evidence certifies nothing (DX0 section 9 lineage)
